headline: Zverev beats Shelton in four: second Slam of 2026, first US Open
whyCareReason: A first two majors in the same season. Shelton took the third set. Zverev took the title 6-2 in the fourth.
teaser: Zverev 6-3, 7-6 (2), 5-7, 6-2 Shelton. 3 hours 33 minutes. Roland Garros, then New York.
story:
Why this one matters: Alexander Zverev already had Roland Garros. On 13 September he added the US Open, 6-3, 7-6 (2), 5-7, 6-2 over Ben Shelton, and became the fourth man in the Open Era to win his first two Grand Slam titles in the same calendar year.

ATP: Shelton double-faulted on break points in the first set. Zverev ran the second-set tie-break 7-2 after a 5-0 start in it. Shelton broke in the 12th game of the third for 7-5. Zverev took the fourth 6-2. Official US Open scores list the same four sets. Duration 3:33.

Shelton had beaten Alcaraz and Tiafoe to get here. The American men's Slam drought since Andy Roddick in 2003 is still the drought. Zverev is 25-2 at majors this year, per ATP.
stakes: A second major of 2026 versus a first American men's finalist in a generation.
rivalryAngle: World No. 1 versus home thunder that had already removed the defending champion.
